variants.label: K1
variants.rationale: 以黄色鸣禽表现轻快的音乐陪伴
variants.shape: A single soft squat pear shape merges a large round head and chubby belly; two short rounded wings merge into the continuous silhouette.
variants.prompt:
Create one complete full-bleed 1:1 square image, approximately 1536 × 1536.
Background: fill the entire square with solid #B7CEC0 muted sage mint. Keep this named background visible in every open area and in the corners not occupied by the character; the assigned emergence corner must be occupied by the character.
Subject: one extremely simplified, cute, endearing baby canary songbird character. A single soft squat pear shape merges a large round head and chubby belly; two short rounded wings merge into the continuous silhouette. Its only defining anatomical feature is a tiny broad short blunt rounded seed-eating beak. The beak is a small rounded wedge, visibly much smaller than the eyes' spacing, never a large duck bill. No crest, eyebrows, eye patches, feet, tail detail, headphones or accessories.
Complexity: one soft rounded continuous outer silhouette built from only 4–7 large basic shapes. At most two broad internal color regions. Two simple small widely spaced round eyes, no mouth, no eye highlights. Remove every nonessential line, feather, anatomical detail, texture and decoration. Readable at 32 × 32.
Color behavior: exactly three semantic colors in the complete image: #F4D252 warm canary yellow for the entire head, body and both wings; #6B4A25 warm dark ochre for the short blunt beak and two small eye dots; #B7CEC0 muted sage mint for the background. Reuse these two character colors without introducing white or black facial details. Keep the silhouette, eyes and background clearly separated.
Composition: upright character emerging from lower-left, filling about 85–95% of the square. Cropping at the bottom or assigned side is welcome. Preserve both paired wings. Never center or bottom-center the character.
Style: simplification, cuteness and lovable baby-like appeal; large head, compact proportions, soft cheeks, thick rounded contours, ultra-clean graphic treatment. Prefer one clear shape over explanatory details. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment.
Finish: only the character on the full-canvas background with clean surfaces and normal square outer corners.
Constraints: Use no text or watermark. Add no borders, frames, cards, or presentation masks. Include one character only, with no extra subjects or scenery. Use no fragile lines, sharp tips, unnecessary outlines, tiny details, or decorative marks. Add no photorealistic material, dramatic bevel, glossy hotspot, deep occlusion, extrusion, strong three-dimensional rendering, or external cast shadow. Keep the background solid and uniform, with no texture, vignette, or lighting variation.
